note: Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003). Its New Testament is on disk (ebible mirror gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/amh_amh); it carries no Old Testament, so every OT quotation is self_rendered in the 1962 register.

The mirror lumps some verse ranges under one marker (e.g. "\\v 1-10") but keeps only the last verse's text, so the earlier verses of such a range are absent (e.g. 1 Peter 1:8, the book's epigraph, and 1 Peter 1:3); those quotations are self_rendered.

A mined row means the Amharic NT wording appears verbatim (a clause of at least 30 characters, or the whole verse) in that block; it was checked mechanically against the on-disk text, not taken from the translators' reports.
